{{Top|leg}}
A '''compression/desiccation chamber''' was used to process organic materials into food concentrates by pressurizing the material, cooling it, and removing all the moisture. It could also be used to preserve game animals as trophies. [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Interrogation (Imperial Security Bureau)/Legends|interrogators]] used a portable compression/desiccation chamber to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]] [[Guerglenar]] and [[Drov]], back-up [[Musician/Legends|singers]] for [[Crying Dawn Singer]].<ref name="Abduction">''[[The Abduction]]''</ref>
